vendor_id: vendor_idology
vendor_name: IDology (ExpectID Platform)
vendor_type: identity_verification
retrieved_at: 2026-10-03

public_resources:
- https://apitracker.io/a/idology
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/partner-idology
- https://cybersecurity-excellence-awards.com/candidates/breakthrough-precision-idologys-expectid-identity-verification-and-fraud-prevention-platform/

key_components:

core_platform:
  name: ExpectID
  architecture: Cloud-based, plug-and-play
  integration_modes: API, web, mobile, middleware
  deployment: RESTful APIs, integrates with Azure AD B2C and other major platforms

verification_methods:
  multi_layered_data_matching: Leverages thousands of data sources
  pii_verification: Name, address, SSN, etc.
  cross_reference: Location, device, behavioral data
  configurable_attributes: Nearly infinite configurations for industry-specific risks
  biometric_and_document: Document authenticity + biometric (selfie/liveness)

document_verification:
  document_types: Government-issued IDs, passports
  authenticity: Scanning and verification
  face_matching: Ensures ID matches real-time capture

fraud_controls:
  real_time_analysis: Identifies and blocks synthetic and stolen identities
  risk_scoring: Behavioral/geolocation analysis
  device_fingerprinting: Device integrity validation
  consortium_network: Real-time fraud intelligence and pattern sharing
  rules_engine: Custom rules, point-and-click configuration for rapid adaptation
  closed_loop_feedback: Analyzes outcomes for continuous improvement
  step_up_authentication: Adaptive risk-based auth with additional verification
  synthetic_identity_detection: Identifies fraudulent identity construction

analytics:
  dashboards: Insight into verification outcomes, fraud trends, behavioral patterns
  audit_support: Compliance reporting, audit logs

compliance:
  standards: KYC/AML ready, BSA/AML, PCI, GDPR
  configurable: Adjust risk models and rules without IT resources

notes:
- Emphasizes multi-layered data matching and consortium fraud intelligence
- Flexible configuration for rapid adaptation to new fraud vectors
- Integration with major cloud platforms (Azure AD B2C)
- Rules engine suggests some configurability but limits not publicly clear
- Full technical details available through direct vendor engagement
